notes: Parser timings exclude imports, grammar initialization and file reading; all parsed datums were checked against Chibi read.
Four parser variants ran sequentially in rotating order, five fresh processes per variant.
Direct compiler timings use the unmodified entry point with --timing; input sources are frozen at base_revision, and all output LLVM hashes match.
Direct compiler samples alternate baseline/both order and include startup, excluding LLVM optimization and Cargo builds.
Instrumented compilation observations are diagnostic only. Reflection, wrappers and imports perturb Chibi allocation/GC behavior; do not use these totals as latency comparisons.
Candidate probes do not change repository implementation. Numeric guard passed existing syntax tests; heap-size and phi-line probes are single runs, not statistically established wins.
Cargo probe changes an LLVM comment to force runner rebuild while retaining dependencies on the second sample; each resulting native program produced Fibonacci 75025.
Generated-compiler runs are single validation observations: identical LLVM was verified for native release, WASI release, and native debug. They are not before/after optimization benchmarks.

harnesses.parser_timing:
(import (scheme base) (scheme file) (scheme read) (scheme write)
        (scheme time) (scheme process-context)
        (snail-scheme reader) (snail-scheme parser)
        (snail-scheme syntax) (snail-scheme syntax-parser))
(define arguments (cdr (command-line)))
(define reader (file->reader (cadr arguments)))
(define start (current-jiffy))
(define result ((if (equal? (car arguments) "factories") (s-file) s-file) reader))
(define elapsed (- (current-jiffy) start))
(unless (parse-result-ok? result) (error "parse failed"))
(define expected
  (call-with-input-file (cadr arguments)
    (lambda (port)
      (let loop ((forms '()))
        (let ((form (read port)))
          (if (eof-object? form) (reverse forms) (loop (cons form forms))))))))
(unless (equal? expected (map syntax->datum (parse-result-value result)))
  (error "datums differ from host reader"))
(write (quotient (* elapsed 1000000) (jiffies-per-second))) (newline)
harnesses.instrumented_compiler:
(import (scheme base) (scheme time) (scheme write) (scheme eval)
        (scheme process-context) (snail-scheme compiler)
        (only (meta) module-env find-module))

(define observations '())
(define (observe category name procedure)
  (lambda arguments
    (let* ((start (current-jiffy)) (result (apply procedure arguments))
           (elapsed (quotient (* (- (current-jiffy) start) 1000000)
                              (jiffies-per-second))))
      (set! observations (cons (list category name elapsed) observations))
      result)))
(define compiler-env (module-env (find-module '(snail-scheme compiler))))
(define (replace! env name procedure)
  (eval (list 'set! name (list 'quote procedure)) env))
(replace! compiler-env 'time-stage
          (lambda (name thunk) ((observe 'stage name thunk))))
(let ((read-source (eval 'read-source compiler-env)))
  (replace! compiler-env 'read-source
            (lambda (path) ((observe 'read path read-source) path))))
(define llvm-env (module-env (find-module '(snail-scheme llvm))))
(for-each
 (lambda (name) (replace! llvm-env name (observe 'llvm name (eval name llvm-env))))
 '(write-data write-vm-instructions write-execution write-initialization
              write-dispatch write-destinations dispatch-targets))
(apply compile-file (cdr (command-line)))
(for-each
 (lambda (row)
   (display (car row)) (display "\t")
   (display (cadr row)) (display "\t")
   (write (car (cddr row))) (newline))
 (reverse observations))

import hashlib, json, os, platform, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/tmp/snail-parser-combinators-20261009')
frozen=Path('/home/nti/Developer/snail-scheme')
build=root/'build/compile-profile'
variants=('baseline','pmap','tuple','both')
report={'base_revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),
        'host':platform.platform(),'parse_samples':[],'compile_samples':[],
        'parser_sha256':{v:hashlib.sha256((build/'variants'/v/'src/snail-scheme/parser.sld').read_bytes()).hexdigest() for v in variants},
        'input_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(frozen)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [frozen/'bootstrap/scheme/base.sld',*sorted((frozen/'src').rglob('*.sld'))]}}
def save(): (build/'ablations.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
def command(variant,script,*args):
    return ['chibi-scheme','-I',str(build/'variants'/variant/'src'),str(script),*[str(a) for a in args]]
for run in range(5):
    order=variants[run%4:]+variants[:run%4]
    for variant in order:
        start=time.monotonic()
        p=subprocess.run(command(variant,'/tmp/snail-parser-values-time.scm','values',frozen/'bootstrap/scheme/base.sld'),cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
        row=dict(run=run+1,variant=variant,parse_us=int(p.stdout),wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
        report['parse_samples'].append(row); save(); print(row,flush=True)
references={}
for run in range(3):
    for workload,path in [('fibonacci',frozen/'examples/fibonacci.scm'),('compiler',frozen/'src/snail-scheme/compile.scm')]:
        for variant in (('baseline','both') if run%2==0 else ('both','baseline')):
            out=build/f'{workload}-{variant}-{run}.ll'
            start=time.monotonic()
            p=subprocess.run(command(variant,'/tmp/snail-compiler-profile.scm',frozen,path,out),cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,check=True)
            rows=[dict(category=c,name=n,microseconds=int(us)) for c,n,us in (line.split('\t') for line in p.stdout.splitlines())]
            digest=hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            if workload in references: assert digest==references[workload],(workload,variant)
            else: references[workload]=digest
            row=dict(run=run+1,workload=workload,variant=variant,wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,output_sha256=digest,observations=rows)
            report['compile_samples'].append(row); save()
            print({k:v for k,v in row.items() if k!='observations'},flush=True)
print('All parse datums checked against host reader; all compiler LLVM outputs match.',flush=True)
